fil: Network Designer: ang Health, Missions, Auto-design at Mga design ay mga tab na sa kanan ng workspace (isang click lang); ang zoom % ay nasa workspace na rin
Network Designer: nananatiling bukas ang dropdown ng End devices, Switching, Wireless at iba pa hanggang i-click ulit, at naaalala kung saan ka huminto
Network Designer: puwede nang i-lock ang shape (right-click → I-lock) para hindi magalaw, mapalaki o mabura nang hindi sinasadya
Network Designer: 100 mission na, mula Basic hanggang Advanced, may progress at filter

Auto-design: nagtatanong tungkol sa mga department (IT, HR, Accounting at iba pa) at kung sino ang puwedeng mag-access sa kanino; gumagawa ng VLAN at ACL bawat department, naka-lock na zone sa floor plan, tag sa bawat device, at inilalagay ang server sa server room
Free plan: 10 Basic lab, 5 lab challenge, Mini exam na 20 tanong, 1 sariling design na may 10 device, at 10 subnetting na tanong bawat araw; makikita ang limit at gamit mo sa Premium at Bayad
en: Network Designer: Health, Missions, Auto-design and Designs are now tabs on the right of the workspace (one click); the zoom % sits on the workspace too
Network Designer: the End devices, Switching, Wireless and other dropdowns stay open until you click them again, and remember where you left off
Network Designer: shapes can be locked (right-click → Lock) so they are not moved, resized or deleted by accident
Network Designer: 100 missions now, from Basic to Advanced, with progress and filters

Auto-design asks about departments (IT, HR, Accounting and more) and who may reach whom; it builds a VLAN and ACL per department, locked zones on the floor plan, a tag on every device, and puts the servers in the server room
Free plan: 10 Basic labs, 5 lab challenges, a 20-question Mini exam, 1 design of your own with 10 devices, and 10 subnetting questions a day; the limits and your use show in Premium & Payments
